assessment.basis: TRACE reconstructs historical genealogical intervals and candidate introgression tracts. The study does not measure a supported pre-intervention cellular phase variable and is outside the primary phase-conditioned cellular-transition benchmark.
assessment.unlock_condition: Not applicable to the reported historical-population analysis. A separate prospective cellular study would require a versioned pre-intervention phase measurement, sample linkage, and leakage-resistant held-out comparison.

admissible_kairos_contributions: temporal ordering of divergence, admixture, and transmission hypotheses
separation of observed genomes from inferred latent source populations
inadmissible_phase_substitutions: divergence time relabelled as cellular phase
admixture date relabelled as pre-intervention phase
ARG branch depth relabelled as biological readiness
posterior introgression state relabelled as causal biological state
